scope: Small metadata only. No point clouds, RGB-D frames, weights, or large dataset archives were downloaded; no registration model was run.

official_protocol.3dmatch_original: 62 real indoor RGB-D scenes; original paper splits 54 training / 8 testing. Each benchmark fragment fuses 50 depth frames using TSDF.
official_protocol.geotransformer_paper: Paper section 4.1 states 46 training / 8 validation / 8 testing scenes. This is a literature statement, not what the downloaded current metadata count shows.
official_protocol.nominal_overlap: 3DMatch >30%; 3DLoMatch 10-30%. Benchmark membership is fixed by author-provided pair lists. Actual overlap columns differ between implementations and do not always obey the nominal intervals.

train.mapping_method: Exact original archive name, otherwise longest original archive prefix plus underscore. This is a name-based mapping, not a point-cloud identity test.

overlap_column.interpretation: Values of this particular metadata field; do not equate to physical occlusion fraction or independently measured geometric overlap.

split_checks.interpretation: Current GeoTransformer metadata share 75 train/val pair paths in analysis-by-synthesis-apt2-kitchen, with identical R/t. This is an artifact audit, not evidence about the authors' historical training run. Its example loader applies no overlap filter by default. Before training, use a documented scene-disjoint validation split; removing this sequence from train would remove 75 rows.
split_checks.predator_train_not_downloaded: HEAD size 4,522,214 bytes; not downloaded to respect the 10 MB total metadata cap. PREDATOR validation/test pair paths and R/t match GeoTransformer exactly.

ground_truth.transform_convention: Source cloud pcd1 to reference cloud pcd0: x_ref = R x_src + t, units meters.
ground_truth.construction: Original benchmark reads fragment camera-to-world transforms and forms inverse(T_world_from_ref) @ T_world_from_src. These originate in registered RGB-D reconstructions. Ground-truth correspondences and the gt.info matrix are then derived from aligned overlapping surfaces.
ground_truth.limits: Reconstruction-derived reference poses are not exact external metrology. Sensor noise, imperfect reconstruction, fusion and sampling remain. This audit cannot measure the error of GT or physical occlusion ratios without the scans and independent references.

evaluation.main: Use the existing 3DMatch/3DLoMatch benchmark evaluator for registration recall (RR), with its gt.log/gt.info transform error and RMSE threshold 0.2 m. Average per scene as the reference script does.
evaluation.supporting: RRE and RTE; correspondence IR with 0.1 m distance threshold; FMR with 5% inlier threshold. Explicitly state whether RRE/RTE summarize all pairs or only accepted pairs; GeoTransformer eval.py reports them only for accepted registrations.
evaluation.warning: Do not substitute nearest-neighbor Chamfer distance or custom RRE/RTE thresholds while calling the result official RR.

storage_checked_without_download.size_limit: Archive byte counts are HTTP Content-Length, while website MB sizes are advertised rounded values. Extracted size not measured.

unknowns: Actual per-fragment point count distribution (point clouds not downloaded)
Physical occlusion ratio and sensor noise distributions
Historical paper train/validation split beyond its written protocol
Precise cause of overlap-field differences between implementations
Model accuracy, runtime, and GPU memory on this environment (not run)
Compatibility of old CUDA/PyTorch implementations with H100 cluster (not tested)
